color-system.twistDescription: Verbatim copy — no modification. color-system is always preserved exactly as extracted from its source.

type-system.twistDescription: Font size scale ×1.2 applied to all heading levels (Twist A). h1: 7.560rem → 9.072rem, h2: 4.320rem → 5.184rem, h3: 2.592rem → 3.110rem, h4: 1.944rem → 2.333rem. Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans (headings) + Inter (body), both confirmed Google Fonts CDN. Letter spacing 0.06em on headings retained.

motion-system.twistDescription: Delay introduction (Twist E): 14 ChapterNav_chapternav-item elements receive staggered animation delays from 0.0s to 1.3s at 0.1s increments, transforming simultaneous group entrance into a sequential cascading reveal. Base animation unchanged: translateY 4px→0px / opacity 0→1, duration 0.7s/0.9s.

grid-system.twistDescription: Gap value scaling ×1.4 (Twist B, expand). bp-540px columnGap: 1.25rem → 1.75rem; bp-768px columnGap and rowGap: 5px → 7px; bp-860px columnGap: 1rem → 1.4rem. Container maxWidth (1328px) and padding (86.3984px) unchanged.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Hero padding emphasis ×1.5 (Twist C). elements.hero paddingTop: 36px → 54px, paddingRight: 16px → 24px, paddingBottom: 36px → 54px, paddingLeft: 16px → 24px. Hero margin values (215px) and all other elements unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Focus state enhancement: raised all outlineWidth values from '0px' to '2px' across all interactive element categories (buttons, inputs, links, cards, navigation). Added outlineOffset: '2px' to the input focus state for explicit keyboard focus rings without altering any color values.

nav-system.twistDescription: Letter spacing introduction: nav link letterSpacing changed from 'normal' to '0.08em'. Font family Inter retained. Height 72px, paddingInline 22px, logo styling preserved. Background remains transparent. Color values unchanged.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Material shift (Twist C) applied to Section 7 (Component Styling). The register of the component styling section was shifted to more material, tactile language — describing surfaces as possessing physical presence and material register rather than abstract geometric properties. All other sections preserved verbatim. concept_by_video.md generated fresh for this system.
